intro: A torn, bloodstained parchment examined during the investigation into Stalvan Mistmantle. A few words remain legible through the thick blood, and Commander Althea Ebonlocke asks that its handwriting be checked.

p: Commander Althea Ebonlocke keeps a vigilant watch over Darkshire and asks for the handwriting on this torn, blood-spattered page to be examined. Despite the thick blood, a few words remain legible enough for Clerk Daltry to compare with the Town Registry.
